problem.title: Maximize Performance of a Team
problem.problemStatement: Given the speed and efficiency of N engineers, choose at most K engineers to maximize the team's performance, where performance is defined as the sum of selected speeds multiplied by the minimum efficiency among the selected engineers.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N and K. • Second line contains N speeds. • Third line contains N efficiencies.
